requirements.quote: A judgment imported with a page that has no text layer gets that page's text from OCR, and its queue row is removed.
With the mock provider, the review stack drains the queue end to end with no AI keys.
A failing page is retried with backoff, then parked with its error; it is never lost.
OCR spend is attributed to the platform scope, never to a workspace.
Admin data ops shows queue depth and parked failures.
Claims queued pages in small batches (`for update skip locked`).
Renders each page from the stored PDF (object key `corpus/<sha256>.pdf`) and runs it through the gateway OCR with a platform (non-workspace) scope.
Writes the text back into the judgment's text, sets the page's text source to `ocr`, deletes the queue row, and records attempts and the last error for retries.
Bounded per run (pages, bytes, AI budget); off by default behind a flag; scheduled when on.
The gateway: a platform scope for corpus OCR that is metered separately from workspaces, using the mock OCR provider when no AI keys are configured (staging review).
`apps/worker`: register the job and schedule, and update `apps/worker/src/__tests__/registry.test.ts` and `schedules.test.ts`.

deliverables.change: Add attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, parked_at to corpusOcrQueue; optional `source?: 'text'|'ocr'` on JudgmentPageText; new global table corpusOcrCall (platform AI call/spend ledger).

Hand-reviewed migration (use next free number, regenerate snapshot in migrations/meta): add queue columns, corpus_ocr_call table, grants SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE on queue and SELECT/INSERT on corpus_ocr_call to causedeck_app, revoke from others.
Add corpus_ocr_call to GLOBAL_TABLES.
Add corpus_ocr_call to root table list.
Register new global tables and every new core runtime export (platform ports, job body, ocrQueueStats) as NOT_A_SERVICE/ SERVICE_TESTS with reason (global, no tenant data).

createPlatformAiPorts(db): GatewayPorts keyed by a constant platform scope: budget from daily sum of corpus_ocr_call vs a platform cap, audit into corpus_ocr_call, no workspace tables touched, no tenant policy (india-only on). Export through packages/core/src/ai/index.ts and add a createPlatformAiGateway that uses mock provider when no providers configured.
Make purpose and idempotency-key prefix overridable in GatewayOcrOptions (default unchanged: capture.ocr / capture-ocr:) so corpus uses `corpus.ocr`.

drainOcrQueue(deps, budget): claim batch FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED (parked_at null, next_attempt_at<=now), fetch PDF via blob store get, render page with PageRenderer, OCR, write page text with source 'ocr' into judgment.page_text, delete row; on failure attempts+1, exponential backoff, park at max with last_error. Bounded by pages, bytes, budget. Export in packages/intelligence/src/index.ts.
Export drainOcrQueue and its types.

defineJob `system.corpus.ocr`: no-op unless CORPUS_OCR_ENABLED; builds platform gateway and object store (reuse blob/store pattern of corpus-bulk-import.ts); schedule every 10 minutes; singleton; exported run function with injectable deps.
Import and register corpusOcr in the list and the type tuple.
Add CORPUS_OCR_ENABLED (default false) and CORPUS_OCR_DAILY_PAISE cap, described.
Document the new env keys.
Add 'system.corpus.ocr'.
Add 'system.corpus.ocr'.
Add ocrQueueStats(db): depth, parked count, and newest parked rows (judgment id, page, attempts, last_error; no content).
Add ocrQueueOverview staff query (capability data-ops, tables corpus_ocr_queue).
Show queue depth and parked failures beside import progress.
Test rendering of queue depth and parked failures.

Integration tests: drain with mock provider removes row and writes ocr text (R1,R2); failure backoff then park, row kept (R3); spend rows land in corpus_ocr_call with no workspace usage rows (R4); disabled flag is a no-op.

storeJudgment queueing contract in packages/intelligence/src/corpus/ingest.ts (rows inserted with only judgmentId, pageNo; onConflictDoNothing) and corpus-bulk-import job/tests.
Workspace gateway ports createAiPorts in packages/core/src/ai/wiring.ts remain tenant-scoped and unchanged.

decisions.choice: Platform scope uses separate global ports and a global corpus_ocr_call ledger rather than a sentinel workspace row.
decisions.justification: Gateway ports and ai_call/usage tables are tenant tables with workspace_id and RLS (packages/core/src/ai/wiring.ts:38-160, packages/db/src/schema/audit.ts:109); a fake workspace would pollute tenant billing and break cross-tenant guards.

decisions.choice: Per-page text source stored as an optional field inside judgment.page_text jsonb, not a new column.
decisions.justification: JudgmentPageText is jsonb (packages/db/src/schema/corpus.ts:24-27,67); additive and backward compatible with readers.

decisions.choice: Feature flag via env CORPUS_OCR_ENABLED, registered in env schema and docs.
decisions.justification: Env keys are registered in packages/config/src/env/schema.ts and docs/engineering/env.md (commit 44021bbe).
